formulas.ascii: Neighbouring cells a and b with data (4 or 8 neighbours) are joined by the conductance 2 / (R(a) + R(b)) / edgeLength, the edge length being the ground distance between cell centres under the grid and cellSizeMode. No-data cells are removed; zero or negative resistance is invalid. Unit current from source cell s to sink cell t is solved by the sparse resistance recipe.
